raw_entities.name: Risk Appetite Statement 2026
raw_entities.description: A formal governance document defining risk tolerance limits for the organisation in 2026. Referenced as a related document establishing the bank's risk appetite framework and tolerance thresholds.

raw_entities.name: Policy Operational Risk
raw_entities.description: A formal policy document establishing the operational risk management framework for the organisation. Defines the approach to identifying, assessing, and managing operational risks across the bank.

raw_entities.name: Escalation Matrix
raw_entities.description: A governance document defining approval authorities and escalation procedures for decision-making across the organisation. Establishes the hierarchy and thresholds for escalating matters to senior management and committees.

raw_entities.name: Incident Response Plan
raw_entities.description: A formal plan documenting the bank's procedures for responding to risk events and incidents. Establishes protocols, responsibilities, and communication procedures to be activated when risks materialise.
context: [[incident_response_plan]] — How to respond if risk occurs
